t1.text: Sign in with mobile number (Digits OTP)

s8.text: Each client picks a template and a font in the setup wizard. Same data and features, different layout. Templates are part of the shared core, so store and booking apps get their own templates later.

s9.text: Embedded apps (iframe): shown live inside the lesson, loaded with the client's site as the origin so it behaves exactly like the website. A full-screen button opens it edge to edge, with rotation. Try the "Embed view" tweak on screen 8c.

s10.text: Iframe sizing: width always fits the screen. Height comes from the embedded page itself when it can report it, from the known ratio for YouTube/Vimeo-style players, or from the height set in the lesson, capped to the screen. Re-measured on rotation.

s1.text: The code is sent through Digits using the waabek gateway configured on the site. New numbers are asked for a name after verification, then the account is created.

s2.text: Course page: the "Enroll now" button shows on Android only and opens the site's own checkout (WooCommerce or the LMS's built-in one) with the student already signed in. On iOS it is hidden. Try the "Platform" tweak on screen 5.

s3.text: Video plays from a temporary signed link, with a watermark showing the student's number, and screen capture is blocked. Supports every video source the LMS offers: direct upload, YouTube, Vimeo and embeds.

t6.text: SaaS platform: website, client dashboard & super admin

t8.text: SaaS website: account, guides & legal pages

s12.text: Legal pages for WEBEK LTD (England and Wales, no. 16326894): UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018, KVKK for Türkiye, EU GDPR. 3-day cancellation, refunds in 5 to 14 business days. Registered office: 71-75 Shelton Street, London WC2H 9JQ.

s6.text: No online payment for now. A client signs up, contacts the team on WhatsApp, and the super admin activates the account and assigns a plan. Then the client fills in the setup wizard and the first build starts.

s7.text: Starter plan: the client gets the files and guides and publishes the apps themselves. Pro plan: the client adds their Google Play and App Store Connect keys, and the platform publishes automatically.

s5.text: Text lessons: HTML, shortcodes and blocks are rendered on the server first. Simple content renders natively with the app's styling; complex content (scripts, iframes, page builders) switches to a secure web view automatically.

s4.text: These settings live in WordPress admin and control the app without publishing a new store update.

s11.text: One plugin, many LMSs: the plugin detects which LMS is installed (Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, LifterLMS, MasterStudy, Sensei, Masteriyo) and uses the matching adapter. The app looks and works the same for all of them.
